sharedChecks.text: Start the document with `SCHEMA_VERSION: 7`, then the root key. Copy section and field names exactly as the Complete field reference spells them.
Write only the sections and fields the source needs. Do not copy the whole reference, and leave no `[placeholder]` value and no `#` comment in the answer.
Write formulas as quoted strings (`"1d6 + 1"`). Write `true`, `false` and plain numbers without quotes.

Keep the complete rules text in `DESCRIPTION.Description`. Add `Activities` and `effects` only when the user asked for a full Item and has 5e Activity Importer; use that module's templates for those blocks.
